blockingIssues.description: The theme still exposes legacy observation colors instead of the required note palette (#5C6D91 light / #7A8DAA dark), so note-related UI cannot resolve the specified Cellar Ledger blue tokens.
The dark M3 theme maps onBackground/onSurface to surface[900] (#F0F2F0) instead of the required bark-charcoal text token #E8E4DE.
StatsCard's icon circle uses borderRadius.sm (4px) rather than the required 10px radius, so it does not meet the Cellar Ledger component contract.
The visible tab set still follows the old IA instead of the requested Home/Farms/Logs/AI/More bottom navigation.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Clarify how workers must report validator failures and procedure compliance when a required validator fails before or during feature work; handoffs should not claim validators passed or full procedure compliance in that state.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: The update-design-tokens review found a transcript with a failing npm test run while the recorded handoff still marked success, validatorsPassed=true, and followedProcedure=true.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Require explicit evidence that both light and dark wireframes were read before visual-task completion, or relax the rule when dark wireframes are unavailable.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: The update-tab-bar review found the transcript only read the light wireframe while AGENTS.md and the ui-worker skill both required reading light and dark variants; the handoff still reported followedProcedure=true.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Add an alternate procedure for component-only/theme-foundation features that have no screen-specific wireframe path, so workers and reviewers are not forced into an ill-fitting screen-wireframe workflow.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: The update-shared-components review found the feature definition only listed component expectations, while the ui-worker skill assumes a screen-specific wireframe implementation flow.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: When the orchestrator completes a feature manually after worker crashes, require a minimal handoff/transcript artifact so later scrutiny reviews have a standard evidence trail.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: The update-shared-components review found no dedicated handoff JSON or worker transcript entry for the manually completed feature and had to infer the implementation commit from git history.

rejectedObservations.observation: The library architecture note describing the current tab layout conflicts with the update-tab-bar feature spec.
rejectedObservations.reason: Rejected as a library update because the discrepancy is mission-specific and should be resolved by orchestrator guidance and follow-up feature work rather than recorded as durable codebase knowledge.
